method: Disposable installed-package observer/test/chat/MCP workflow on this Mac; separate compiled extension tests and live local-model read

live_model_trial.question: Why did we use a local browser dashboard instead of another service?
live_model_trial.finding: The answer added claims about users in areas with limited connectivity and improved performance. The cited decision only records keeping the MVP offline and lightweight.

limits: Observer CPU/RSS is a 5-second Python-only sample; Git and Ollama processes, sustained swap, and cold model load were not measured.
The workflow ran with Wi-Fi on; earlier separate physical Wi-Fi-off CLI/chat/MCP trials did not include the extension or a full observer/test workflow.
VS Code editor-host visuals, keyboard navigation, theme appearance, and real restart behavior were not exercised.
The installed VS Code extension differs from the newly compiled source; current source was exercised through simulated VS Code tests.
Model prose accuracy is not established by valid citations; the live trial contained unsupported detail.
